column1: # *** THE 1811 BAPTISM OF LUIS ESCOLASTICO - AND IT NAMES SANCHO'S PARENTS. 14 September 2026. ***
# Catedral de la Inmaculada Concepcion y San Felipe y Santiago (Iglesia Matriz), Montevideo,
# 10 February 1811. Found by a full-text search for the phrase "Sancho Llerena" - the same search
# this archive had run before, returning a result it had never opened.
# *** Four things that were tree-only or census-only are now on a parish act. ***
*** SANCHO'S PARENTS ARE ON AN ACT: FELIX LERENA AND ROSALIA AGUILAR ***
column2: *** "Abuelos paternos FELIZ GERENA y ROS[A]LIA AGUILAR" *** - the paternal grandparents of the child being baptised, who is Sancho's son.
column3: *** PRIMARY - a parish act, full-text transcript read here, ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-X7F6-M ***
column4: *** THIS RETIRES THE SINGLE BIGGEST WEAKNESS IN THIS ARCHIVE'S SPANISH LINE. *** Yesterday the parentage rested on ONE un-consulted article - the Geneanet pages of Felix and Rosalia carry no dates, no places and no other children, only the line "Family: Revista 15 IEGU" - and this archive said so in every file that used it. *** It is now on a Montevideo parish act of 1811, written while Sancho was alive and standing at the font of his own son. *** *** GERENA is the machine's G-for-L, the seventh variant recorded for this family *** - and it is the same variant that produced the unresolved "Dona Andugara GERENA" at Santa Rosa de Lima image 131, which this proves is a real failure mode on this exact surname.

column1: *** SANCHO IS "NATURAL DE ANDALUCIA" - ON AN ACT, NOT A CENSUS ***
column2: *** "hijo legitimo de Don SANCHO LLERENA natural de ANDALUCIA" ***
column4: The Uruguayan census of 1726-1858 gave his birthplace as "ANDALUZIA" and that has been the only evidence for it. *** A second, independent, contemporaneous document now says the same word. *** *** CORDOBA specifically is STILL NOT ON ANY ACT *** - it comes from the trees, which cite Apolant ficha 355. Andalucia is documented twice; Cordoba remains a lead.

column1: *** AND MARIA FERNANDEZ IS "NATURAL DE ASTURIAS" ***
column2: *** "y de Dona MARIA FERNANDEZ natural de ASTURIAS. ... idem maternos RODRIGO FERNANDEZ y ROSA FERNANDEZ" ***
column4: *** THIS CONFIRMS THE OPERATIVO PATAGONIA READING FROM A URUGUAYAN ACT. *** Yesterday her Asturian origin came from a tree quoting Apolant ficha 355, backed by the migration literature: 41 Asturian founder families, seven of them from MORCIN, who founded San Jose in 1783. *** An act now says ASTURIAS in her own lifetime. *** *** And it names her parents RODRIGO FERNANDEZ and ROSA FERNANDEZ *** - the same couple the trees give, the same couple FamilySearch's index reads as maternal grandparents at the 1812 Malbarea font, and the same Rodrigo Fernandez, 63, asturiano, whom the 1812 padron puts living in Sancho's household. *** Four independent supports, one of them now an act. ***

column1: *** AND IT IS LUIS'S OWN BAPTISM, WITH A DAY ON IT ***
column2: *** "En diez de Febrero de mil ochocientos once ... bautice solemnemente a LUIS ESCOLASTICO que nacio ayer" *** - Iglesia Matriz de Montevideo, Presbitero Juan Loberas; padrinos Don Luis Jose Avila y Dona Juana Josefa Guispez.
column4: *** LUIS LERENA - the son through whom this whole archive descends - was BORN 9 FEBRUARY 1811 and baptised the next day. *** The trees gave "1811" and nothing more. *** His baptism act has never been in this archive until now. ***
